Quick links

- `src/` — application source code (TypeScript).
- `workflows/` — example workflow JSONC files used for seeding/import.
- `src/modules/` — extension modules (triggers, actions, credentials, etc.).
- `docker-compose.yml` & `Dockerfile` — containerized deployment.
- `kind-config.yaml` — example Kubernetes-in-Docker setup for local testing.

This file contains a short introduction. See the `docs/` directory for more detailed developer, deployment, and API documentation:

- `docs/README.md` — project overview and quick start
- `docs/DEPLOY.md` — build, Docker Compose, and Kubernetes instructions
- `docs/WORKFLOWS.md` — how workflows are authored & seeded
- `docs/MODULES.md` — module structure and extension points
- `docs/API.md` — public HTTP API endpoints and authentication
